prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original anime/game female character-design atlas contact sheet.
Primary request: illustrate EXACTLY 16 DISTINCT ordered catalog examples faithfully.
Layout: SQUARE 2048x2048 canvas, EXACTLY 4 EQUAL COLUMNS by 4 EQUAL ROWS. Thin straight light-gray grid rules at exactly quarter axes; regular equal cells with generous internal margins. Row-major reading left to right then down. NO title, NO footer, NO extra inset panels. Put only the exact ID in small dark crisp sans-serif at top left of each cell; no other text.
Style: polished professional 2D anime reference drawing, clean fine outlines, restrained cel shading, warm ivory backgrounds, natural adult facial anatomy. Original mature ADULT women age25-45 only, nonsexual everyday reference portraits. Fine details remain legible at thumbnail scale. No watermark or logos, no generic symbols, no overlapping cells. Each named difference must actually be observable.
Subject direction: Full head, all hair and upper shoulders of mature adult women. Hair occupies most of each cell; show fine versus coarse strands, airy versus heavy density, sheen, frizz and curl texture exactly. Dark-brown hair in every cell reduces color distraction. Vary hair shape only as necessary to show the listed surface. Plain opaque high-neck clothing. Leave ample margins around the complete hair silhouette.
Specific ordered cells:
Cell 1, label HS047: fine flat straight hair / 细软贴服直发. Visible feature: 发丝纤细、发根贴近头部，长直发束轻薄顺落，轮廓窄而柔软。
Cell 2, label HS048: fine airy flyaway hair / 细软轻飘碎发. Visible feature: 浅细发丝松散飘离主发束，发缘有轻薄毛羽，整体通透轻盈。
Cell 3, label HS049: coarse upright short hair / 粗硬直立短发. Visible feature: 粗硬短束在头顶向上支起，侧缘短而清楚，保持明显支撑感。
Cell 4, label HS050: thick heavy straight hair / 粗厚饱满直发. Visible feature: 直发由粗厚束群形成饱满体积，发尾厚实，外缘清楚而不飘散。
Cell 5, label HS051: satin-soft hair sheen / 丝缎柔亮发束. Visible feature: 中长发顺着柔和弧面落下，表面是一条宽而柔的丝缎亮带。
Cell 6, label HS052: glass-straight glossy hair / 镜面顺直光泽. Visible feature: 整齐长直发有边缘清晰、连续平直的高光带，发缘非常平滑。
Cell 7, label HS053: soft matte hair finish / 柔雾哑光发质. Visible feature: 中长发只有柔弱漫反射，发束层次清楚，没有锐利镜面光条。
Cell 8, label HS054: cottony fluffy curls / 蓬松棉感卷发. Visible feature: 细小卷束堆叠出轻软蓬松体积，发缘有少量细毛，轮廓柔圆。
Cell 9, label HS055: frizzy halo hair edge / 毛羽外散发缘. Visible feature: 主体自然波浪，外围细碎发丝向外散开，出现毛羽光晕般的边缘。
Cell 10, label HS056: airy lifted-root layers / 根部蓬松轻层发. Visible feature: 头顶发根撑起空气层，耳侧与发尾分成轻薄小束，体积不压向头皮。
Cell 11, label HS057: dense weighty hair panels / 厚重垂坠发片. Visible feature: 长发像厚发片沿肩部垂下，分缝少，发尾有明确重量与低垂弧度。
Cell 12, label HS058: fine spring-coil texture / 细密弹簧卷纹. Visible feature: 细小紧密的弹簧卷保持独立圈形，卷群密度均匀，边缘可辨单个小卷。
Cell 13, label HS059: chunky rope-like curls / 粗束绳状卷纹. Visible feature: 宽而连续的粗卷束向下盘旋，卷束之间有明显间隔，区别于细碎紧卷。
Cell 14, label HS060: mixed loose-wave textures / 自然混合波卷. Visible feature: 同一头发中混合松S波、少量直束和小弯发尾，保留有规律的自然差异。
Cell 15, label HS061: feather-light layered ends / 碎层羽毛感发尾. Visible feature: 上层较顺，末端切成很多细薄层次，发尾像羽毛般向外轻轻分散。
Cell 16, label HS062: low-density separated strands / 低密度透隙发束. Visible feature: 成年中长发束之间可看到少量背景缝隙，分线较宽，轻量发尾不画成厚发片。
Critical: correct ID, exact row-major sequence and equal4x4 grid; full feature fits within its own cell. These are individual vocabulary illustrations, not one scene.

Cell 10, label HS072: platinum cool-white hair / 铂金冷白发. Visible feature: 高明度冷白金色，细束阴影为淡灰紫，高光接近白色。
Cell 11, label HS073: dusty rose-pink hair / 灰粉玫瑰发. Visible feature: 低饱和玫瑰粉混灰色，发束暗部有灰莓调，整体柔和不鲜艳。

Cell 15, label HS077: salt-and-pepper interwoven hair / 银黑细丝交混发. Visible feature: 黑发与银白细丝均匀交错，不是左右分区，发缘也能看出白黑混合。
Cell 16, label HS078: pearl pastel iridescent hair / 珍珠多色偏光发. Visible feature: 珍珠浅色底发在不同发束反射淡粉、淡蓝与淡紫，保留真实发束纹理。
